summary.text: Priscilla Gonzalez is a Democratic candidate on the ballot for Louisiana's 3rd Congressional District. A marketing director born in McAllen, Texas, she ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Born in McAllen, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from Fort Hays State University.
Her career experience includes working as a marketing director.
Ran for this seat as a Democrat in the November 5, 2024 primary, receiving 59,834 votes (18.7 percent); Clay Higgins won outright with 70.6 percent.
